name: Vera Costa
text: I have had a traumatic experience surfing when I was younger and since then I never managed to surf average size waves without being anxious or fearful. I did the surf survival workshop in Freedive Rote and it was really amazing. With such simple and accessible concepts and exercises I managed to regain my confidence naturally. I am looking forward to have one more extra day of training as it was worth every second. Highly recommend.

name: Paul McMahon
text: Doing the course with Kwab at Freedive Rote just before a massive swell hit was hands down the best call I could have made. Kwab is an exceptional coach, calm, incredibly patient, and clearly backed by years of deep ocean experience. He has top quality gear and creates an environment where you feel completely supported from the minute you start. If you are a surfer wanting to overcome fear and perform better in heavy water, or anyone looking to get into freediving in Rote, do not hesitate. Freedive Rote is absolute world class.

name: Emma Perrier
text: I did the freediving course with Kwab and it was such an interesting and amazing experience. I highly recommend anyone who wants to get more confidence in the water, or who is genuinely interested in getting more knowledge about breath hold, to do this course.

name: Adrian Bailey
text: This is so good. I think everyone should do this course whether you are a land based person or someone who spends their time in the ocean. You will gain so much from it. There are so many elements that you can apply to day to day life. Kwab has a vast amount of experience and knowledge in this field. The classes are insightful and fun, all set in a beautiful location. Go ahead and book it.

name: Mick Lavery
text: I had been waiting for an opportunity to learn the art of freediving in Bali but took the opportunity to join Kwab now that he is providing this service in Rote. He provides an excellent course with amazing outcomes. A great experience, and another skillset to add to surf trips.

name: Adi Khodja
text: Outstanding experience with a very knowledgeable instructor who made it fun and interesting. Did my level 1 refresher and my wave recovery and truly enjoyed it. Thanks Kwab.

name: Marcelo Wesseler
text: This was an amazing experience for our family of 4. Kwab is a very good teacher, and there is so much to learn from him. Diving so deep without any gear was so fun, and our kids (10 and 12) absolutely loved it. The class also helped the kids with surfing, and they are still doing the breath-holding exercises 6 months later.

name: A. Ivanova
text: We had such a great day out on the water with Freedive Rote. The whole trip was very well organised, from the boat and route to the different spots we visited. We explored some really vibrant, largely untouched reefs around the offshore islands, and had the chance to dive around one of the islands, which was definitely a highlight. What made the trip especially great was the guidance. Since the trip was led by a professional freediver and instructor, we also got lots of practical tips on how to approach the dives safely and efficiently. If you’re in Rote and want to spend a day exploring the ocean, I’d definitely recommend it.
